name: host memory — kernel-available RAM below 8 GiB on any host (critical floor)
description: Fires per host.name when MIN(system.linux.memory.available) is below 8 GiB in two consecutive 15-min evaluations: the late, critical alarm. The committed successor of the hand-made agent-activity trigger bEVsU9BQw22 (same query and floor since its 2026-11-04 re-pointing; livespec-orchestrator-beads-fabro plan address-honeycomb-alerts, notes 002 and 011), moved into the livespec env so apply-triggers.sh --drift sees it. Covers every host whose collector sends system.linux.memory.available to the livespec metrics dataset. The early warning is dev-host-memory-available-share. Runbook: free -g; df -h /tmp /dev/shm; ps aux --sort=-rss | head; on vmi3006760 also /var/tmp/vps-load-guard.sh. Owner: legacy-coordinator-agent routing, kubernetes-observability seat.
